summary: An owned, growable string backed by a null-terminated buffer.

types.name: struct string
types.description: A struct that owns mutable string storage and tracks its length and capacity.

functions.name: clone
functions.description: Copies an owned string into a new allocation.

functions.name: from_str
functions.description: Creates an owned string from a string reference.

functions.name: from_span
functions.description: Creates an owned string from a character span.

functions.name: try_new_string
functions.description: Attempts to allocate an empty owned string.
functions.returnDescription: Some string on allocation success or none on failure.

functions.name: append
functions.description: Appends a string reference to an owned string.

functions.name: append_char
functions.description: Appends one character to an owned string.

functions.name: as_str
functions.description: Views an owned string as a string reference.
functions.returnDescription: A reference to the null-terminated string data.

functions.name: str_length
functions.description: Returns the length of a string reference.

functions.name: substring
functions.signature: string string::substring(const string& this, usize start, usize end)
functions.description: Copies a range from an owned string.
functions.returnDescription: A new string containing the selected range.

functions.name: substring
functions.signature: string str::substring(const _str& this, usize start, usize end)
functions.description: Copies a range from a string reference.
functions.returnDescription: A new string containing the selected range.

functions.name: equals
functions.signature: bool string::equals(const string& this, const string& other)
functions.description: Compares two owned strings for equality.
functions.returnDescription: True when both strings contain the same bytes.

functions.name: equals
functions.description: Compares two string references for equality.
functions.returnDescription: True when both strings contain the same bytes.
